provenance.derivation: STATE_V2 = frozen MARKET_BEHAVIOR sequence + minimum-dwell lifecycle (k=2)

why_lifecycle.phase1_finding: the frozen MARKET_BEHAVIOR is a per-bar classifier with NO persistence requirement: churn 0.6473 (short M15) / 0.6292 (20-month M15) / 0.6194 (H1); duration median = 1 bar at M5, M15 and H1; surrogate random series (same returns) churn 0.618-0.624 ~= observed

phase1_attribution.F_no_hysteresis: DOMINANT — min-dwell k=2 on the SAME frozen labels lifts median duration 1 -> 5 bars and cuts churn 0.6473 -> 0.1507
phase1_attribution.E_not_market_specific: DOMINANT — churn is a property of the labeler applied to any similar-volatility series
phase1_attribution.B_scale_invariant: churn ~= 0.61-0.67 at M5, M15, H1 => label is re-drawn per bar
phase1_attribution.A_dead_branch: REVERSAL_ATTEMPT branch is UNREACHABLE (labeler never emits REGIME=REVERSAL)

state_definition.STATE_V2(t): the most recent frozen MARKET_BEHAVIOR label that has persisted for >= k consecutive bars, carried forward otherwise
state_definition.k_chosen_by: pre-registered from Phase 1 diagnostics (k=2 was the smallest dwell that collapsed churn from 0.6473 to 0.1507); NOT tuned against any target metric

lifecycle.entry: a candidate label C != current(current) is registered; C becomes the state once it has been observed k consecutive bars
lifecycle.exit: the current state exits only by the entry of a new state (no separate exit rule)
lifecycle.persistence: runs of the accepted label; minimum run length = k bars by construction
lifecycle.carry_forward: bars whose candidate has not yet reached k are labelled with the current accepted state

limitations: research-only; the frozen C1 ontology and all frozen registries are UNCHANGED and unwritten
features are pure OHLC-derived (labeler outputs excluded) — no circularity — but the TARGET is the labeler's own output, so this measures predictability of the C1 state space, not of returns
no order, no broker write, no forward/shadow/live; no future return, PnL or win-rate used anywhere
single instrument (XAUUSD M15) and single 20-month window; H4 excluded (sample too small)
